_note: Official colours from the Ozone logo. 'accent' is for fills (buttons, stripes, charts) with 'accent_ink' text on it; 'accent_text' is the readable version for links and text on white. 'logo' is for light backgrounds, 'logo_on_dark' (white lettering) for the navy headers. The logo already contains the name, so show_name_with_logo is false.
